title: Live Earth
description:
Live Earth was a 24-hour concert that took place at a series of venues all across the world, featuring more than 100 artists. Kanye would perform his set at Giants Stadium in New Jersey. This is the concert where the infamous clip of Kanye sprinting back-and-forth across stage originates from. Here is the tracklist:

1. Gold Digger
2. Stronger
3. Diamonds from Sierra Leone (Bonus Track)
4. Can't Tell Me Nothing
5. Jesus Walks
6. Touch The Sky
